summary: A cleaned CSV of 100,000+ certified H-1B Labor Condition Application (LCA) filings from DOL OFLC quarterly disclosure data — publicly downloadable with no authentication required. Each record includes employer name, city, state, NAICS code, job title, SOC occupation code, wage offered, prevailing wage, visa type (H-1B/H-1B1/E-3), case status, and number of workers requested. H1BGrader.com, MyVisaJobs.com, and H1Base.com all charge $19–$49/month to search this exact data. A one-time $49 flat file on Gumroad targets immigration attorneys prospecting for new corporate clients, staffing agencies identifying active H-1B sponsors, and HR teams benchmarking visa wages — all segments that currently pay recurring fees for search access to the same DOL public records.

audience.who: Immigration attorneys who need a list of companies that filed H-1B petitions in the past 12 months — each certified employer is a potential law firm client for renewals, amendments, and green card sponsorship; staffing agencies and recruiting firms specializing in visa-eligible candidates (tech, engineering, finance) who need to identify companies actively sponsoring H-1Bs; corporate HR and talent acquisition benchmarking visa wage levels against competitors in the same occupation and metro; B2B SaaS companies selling to HR and legal teams (ATS vendors, immigration workflow platforms) who need a prospect list of active H-1B sponsors.

data_wanted: DOL OFLC H-1B LCA Performance Disclosure Data — quarterly flat files published at https://www.dol.gov/agencies/eta/foreign-labor/performance. Most recent: FY2026 Q1 at https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ETA/oflc/pdfs/LCA_Disclosure_Data_FY2026_Q1.xlsx. Key fields per case: employer name, employer address (street, city, state, ZIP), employer NAICS code, SOC code (occupation), job title, total workers requested, begin date, end date, visa class (H-1B/H-1B1/E-3), wage rate offered (annual), wage unit of pay, prevailing wage, prevailing wage source, case status (certified/denied/withdrawn), case number. Downloadable as XLSX with no login or API key required. Combine FY2024 Q1–Q4 and FY2025 Q1–Q4 for a full 2-year picture (~200,000 certified cases).

evidence.source: H1BGrader — paid search platform built entirely on DOL LCA data, charges $14.99–$29.99/month for premium search access with employer history and wage analytics
evidence.quote: H1BGrader provides detailed H-1B sponsor reports, including approval rates, wage data, and attorney information — all sourced from Department of Labor LCA and USCIS public records. Premium plans start at $14.99/month.

evidence.source: MyVisaJobs — charges $19.99/month for H-1B employer search and LCA data access, proves recurring willingness-to-pay for searchable LCA records
evidence.quote: MyVisaJobs Premium: $19.99/month — access H-1B employer sponsorship history, LCA wage data, and approval statistics for 300,000+ sponsoring companies.

evidence.source: DOL OFLC Performance Data — official source for all LCA disclosure data, quarterly XLSX files, no authentication required
evidence.quote: The Office of Foreign Labor Certification (OFLC) generates program data that provides public disclosure information for H-1B, H-2A, H-2B, and PERM cases. LCA Disclosure Data is published quarterly.

evidence.source: AILA (American Immigration Lawyers Association) — notes the OFLC Q1 FY2026 data was released publicly, confirming the quarterly cadence and attorney usage of this data for prospecting and benchmarking
evidence.quote: OFLC Releases Public Disclosure Data and Selected Program Statistics for Q1 of FY26. Immigration practitioners regularly use this data to analyze sponsorship trends and employer activity.

willingness_to_pay.signal: Three active paid products (H1BGrader, MyVisaJobs, H1Base) charge $15–$49/month for search access to the identical DOL data. Buyers are immigration attorneys (who bill $300–$500/hour and happily pay $30/month for prospecting lists), staffing firms (whose H-1B placement fees are $15K–$30K per hire), and HR teams benchmarking wages. A $49 flat CSV of all certified H-1B LCA cases from FY2024–2025 (~200,000 records) destroys the recurring fee model: same data, one payment, instant download. The pitch is obvious: 'same data as H1BGrader, $49 once vs. $30/month forever.'

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad one-time download + LinkedIn posts targeting immigration attorneys and HR/talent leaders at tech companies + r/immigration and r/h1b subreddit contextual posts + direct outreach to solo immigration attorney practices via LinkedIn
first_sale_path.angle: Title: 'H-1B LCA Employer Database FY2024–2025 — 200,000+ Certified Cases, Wages & NAICS Codes (CSV)'. Key selling points: (1) Every employer that filed a certified H-1B LCA in FY2024 and FY2025 — company name, city, state, job title, SOC code, wage offered, and number of workers, (2) Same source as H1BGrader and MyVisaJobs — the DOL OFLC quarterly disclosure files, (3) One-time $49 instant CSV download — not $30/month forever. Immigration attorney angle: 'Build your prospect list — every company in your state that sponsored H-1Bs last year, filtered by occupation code.' Staffing agency angle: 'Find every active H-1B sponsor in tech, engineering, and finance — 200,000+ companies, one file.'

ceo_decision.notes: Score 8, DOL XLSX download, immigration attorney buyers are high-value, destroys recurring fee model of H1BGrader
